'''Mason Johnson New Age Chevin Barbecue''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Mason Johnson]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-13936">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13936 New Age Chevin Barbecue], DeckTech (Mason "Palleon" Johnson, 22 February 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/13936/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/13936/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018045600/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/13936/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Mason Johnson]]
* '''Published:''' 22 February 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''New Age Chevin Barbecue''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR2 HD Johnson DS 2001 13936.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' A new way to play Hunt Down. Basiscs are the same, but it has some nasty twists.

== Original post ==

'''New Age Chevin Barbecue'''
* '''Author:''' Mason "Palleon" Johnson
* '''Published:''' February 22, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 3.0
* '''Description:''' A new way to play Hunt Down. Basiscs are the same, but it has some nasty twists.

=== Strategy ===

Everyone Knows how to Play Hunt Down. This deck is very solid and it is fun to play. IT is solid against most decktypes and has a few changes which I haven't seen lately in Hunt Down.

Thanks for Reading
